runSummary.note: Fresh 11.9.2026 08:07 sweep searched current Profesia Bratislava administration/customer-support indexes, Kariera/Zoznam customer support, Práca za rohom details, official IKEA careers and current BA technical/support discovery. PORT System Slovakia customer support is a new promotion-grade match: Petržalka, 1750-2000 EUR, Po-Pi, low physical burden, basic English only and internal training. Slovak Telekom B2B support, IKEA after-sales contact centre and SUPTel dispatch administration were genuinely reopened/reconfirmed. SuperFaktura was not auto-promoted because its current detail asks mildly advanced English; RFA asks intermediate English; FINAL-CD OPEL assistant also shows mildly advanced English plus similar-practice/accounting expectations.
